title: Roles
subtitle: Manage global roles and permissions.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view roles.
forbidden_write: You do not have permission to manage roles.
empty_description: Create a role to assign permissions to users.
create_description: Define a new role and select permissions from the catalog.
edit_description: Update name, description, and assigned permissions.
detail_not_found: Role was not found or could not be loaded.
fields.name: Name
form.section_details_desc: Name and slug identify the role.
form.section_permissions_desc: Select permissions from the read-only catalog.
validation.name: Name is required
validation.slug_format: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only
permissions_empty_description: This role has no permissions assigned.
system_role_edit_forbidden: System roles cannot be edited or deleted.

descriptions.center_owner: Every center department (staff, warehouse, accounting, social, service point) in one role.
descriptions.center_staff: Services, customers, orders and the dealer network; sees no prices.
descriptions.center_warehouse: Warehouse, stock and shipping; sees no prices.
descriptions.center_accounting: Accounting, prices (purchase and sale) and e-invoices.
descriptions.center_service: The center's own service point: services, customers, warranties and appointments; sees no prices, no warehouse or accounting.
descriptions.center_sales: Dealer orders, sale prices and discounts, dealers, services and customers (read) and reports; no purchase prices, warehouse or accounting.
descriptions.distributor_owner: The distributor's prices, accounting, warehouse and dealer network.
descriptions.distributor_staff: Services and dealers of the subtree.
descriptions.distributor_warehouse_staff: Warehouse and shipping, reads the dealers; sees no prices.
descriptions.distributor_accounting: Accounting, prices and the "Invoiced" mark on orders.
descriptions.dealer_owner: The dealer's final prices, accounting and stock.
descriptions.dealer_staff: The dealer's services and own records; sees no prices or accounting.
